therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: technetium-99m methylene diphosphonate bone targeting and mineralization enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: bone mineral density improvement and osteoporosis treatment
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: postmenopausal women with differentiated thyroid cancer and osteoporosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: percent change of bone mineral density in lumbar and hip

results.effect_size: 3.8% lumbar spine BMD increase at 12 months (99Tc-MDP) vs 5.1% (Fosamax)
biomarker_changes: PINP increased from 43.8 to 52.6 ng/ml in 99Tc-MDP arm
CTX decreased from 0.47 to 0.37 ng/ml in 99Tc-MDP arm
PINP decreased from 29.3 to 20.6 ng/ml in Fosamax arm
CTX increased from 0.15 to 0.18 ng/ml in Fosamax arm

context.indication: osteoporosis in postmenopausal women with differentiated thyroid cancer
